title: Keeping Up With Science #3: Space Exploration & Commercializing Mars

teacherNotes.title: Session Goal
teacherNotes.content: Discuss space economy, public vs private space exploration (NASA vs SpaceX), space mining, and Mars colonization.

elements.content: Share your thoughts with the group:

1. If offered a one-way ticket to live in a human colony on Mars, would you go?
2. Is spending billions on space exploration justified when we face pressing issues on Earth?
Examine the role of private companies in space:

• Space tourism for the ultra-wealthy vs scientific discovery.
• Who owns resources mined from asteroids or the Moon?
